events-forms-and-user-input.label: Events, Forms, and User Input
events-forms-and-user-input.summary: Respond to clicks, handle form submission without reloading, and read values from form controls.

try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch0.title: Try it yourself: Reveal a study tip
try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch0.prompt: Now apply what you just learned in this task. Problem: A study tip should appear only after the learner asks for it instead of being permanently visible. Task: When `#tip-button` is clicked, change `#tip` to `"Review for 10 minutes"`. Expected result: clicking the button reveals the study tip in the Preview. Produce the result for reveal a study tip so it reinforces Events, Forms, and User Input.
try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch0.hint: Put the page update inside a function registered for click.

try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch1.title: Try it yourself: Handle a nickname form
try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch1.prompt: Now apply what you just learned in this task. Problem: A nickname form should display what the learner entered without reloading the page and losing the interaction. Task: Handle `#nickname-form`, prevent the default submit, read `#nickname`, and show the value in `#nickname-output`. Expected result: submitting the form keeps the page in place and displays the entered nickname. Produce the result for handle a nickname form so it reinforces Events, Forms, and User Input.
try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch1.hint: Read the current value inside the submit handler.

help.concept: A submit handler can stop navigation and use the form's current data.
help.hint_1: The handler needs the event parameter.
help.hint_2: Call preventDefault before copying the input value into the output.

try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch2.title: Try it yourself: Track a theme selection
try_events_forms_and_user_input_sketch2.prompt: Now apply what you just learned in this task. Problem: A theme settings screen needs to react when the learner chooses a different option. Task: When `#theme-choice` changes, show its current value in `#theme-output` using `event.currentTarget.value`. Expected result: changing the selection immediately updates the visible theme value. Produce the result for track a theme selection so it reinforces Events, Forms, and User Input.

events-choice.title: Choose the right idea
events-choice.prompt: Which line registers `showMenu` to run later when `button` is clicked?
events-choice.hint: Focus on the responsibility described by the question.

help.concept: The correct option matches the specific job the code needs to do.
help.hint_1: Separate DOM, data, events, and async responsibilities.
help.hint_2: Choose the behavior that directly produces the requested outcome.

events-multi.title: Recognize correct behavior
events-multi.prompt: Which statements about forms and events are true?
events-multi.hint: More than one statement can be correct.

help.concept: This check separates the responsibilities introduced in the lesson.
help.hint_1: Keep only statements that match the actual JavaScript or browser behavior.
help.hint_2: Reject statements that assign the concept a different job.

options.a: preventDefault can stop normal form navigation.
options.b: An input value can be read with .value.
options.c: A submit listener can run a handler.
